_meta.what: Retrieval labels for the 18 generated Docs-mode questions (Phase 1 step 1.5).
_meta.how_labels_work: A chunk counts as a HIT if it contains ALL the phrases in 'evidence' (case, dashes and spaces ignored). Labelled by TEXT, not by chunk id, so the labels survive Phase 3 re-chunking — chunk ids change when documents are re-cut, the words in them do not. It also means a fact stated in two places counts wherever it is found.
_meta.checked: 2026-09-18: every label matches its own source chunk, and matches 1-2 of the 29 official WM-101 chunks (never a loose match). Where 2 chunks match, both genuinely answer the question.
